description: This file defines configuration and helper classes for Redis-based reminder storage in Orleans. It includes options for Redis connection configuration, a delegate to create Redis connections asynchronously, and a validator class to ensure necessary options are set.

classes.name: RedisReminderTableOptions
classes.description: Holds configuration options for Redis, including connection options and connection factory delegate, with an expiry setting for ephemeral environments.

classes.name: RedactRedisConfigurationOptions
classes.description: Custom attribute class for redacting sensitive Redis configuration information.

classes.name: RedisReminderTableOptionsValidator
classes.description: Validates that necessary Redis reminder options are configured properly, particularly the ConnectionOptions.

methods.name: DefaultCreateMultiplexer
methods.description: Default static method to create a Redis connection multiplexer asynchronously using the provided configuration options.

methods.name: Redact
methods.description: Method overriding string redaction for Redis ConfigurationOptions, avoiding password exposure.

methods.name: ValidateConfiguration
methods.description: Checks whether the Redis ConfigurationOptions are set; throws exception if not.
